GEOG201 Human & Physical Geography
Assessment Notification

Task: Weather, People & Place — Midterm Exam
Weighting: 30% of your course grade
Covers: Weeks 3 to 9

This assessment has two parts.

Part A: Research notes
Due: Wednesday 23 September, 11:59pm. Submit your research notes through Canvas. There is no word limit.
For Part A you choose one commodity to research: coffee or chocolate. Tell your teacher which you have chosen before you begin.

Part B: In-class test
Date: Friday 25 September, in class. You will have 40 minutes of writing time.

Use of AI tools
AI tools may be used for idea generation and brainstorming only, before Part A is submitted. AI tools are not permitted at all during Part B.

What you will be marked on
You need to be able to discuss:
- atmospheric circulation
- urban growth
- land degradation
- rainfall patterns and climate zones
- population distribution
- rural to urban migration
- ecosystems and biomes
- sustainable land management

You will also be assessed on how well you communicate using a range of examples and geographical concepts.
